messages:
ana (SDK): Quick heads-up: planned SDK release v1.5.0 tomorrow 09:00 PT. This removes the legacy `--compat-mode` flag and makes the modern response contract the default. Docs + release ops please review migration notes. @maria @sam

maria (Docs): Noted. Can you drop a short migration snippet and the exact compatibility matrix change? I'll prepare a changelog banner and a small FAQ.

ana (SDK): PR: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/sdk/pulls/523 (draft). Migration snippet:```python
# before
client = RedwoodClient(compat_mode=True)
# after
client = RedwoodClient()
```
Behavior: default output formatting now aligns with hosted runtime; clients explicitly relying on compat_mode should either remove the flag and test or pin fallback model `redwood/compat-legacy:2025-11`.

sam (Release): Rollout plan: canary 10% x30m -> 50% x15m -> 100% if stable. Rollback: `./release_tool rollback --tag v1.5.0` and fallback runtime is `redwood/compat-legacy:2025-11`. Need docs signed off and QA green before canary.

oliver (DevEx): Please add a small regression test for structured output shapes. We had a customer edge case earlier.

ana (SDK): Added tests/tests_structured_output.py in the PR.

qa-bot: preflight checks green. Compatibility-suite queued.

maria (Docs): Drafted changelog banner and FAQ. Banner copy: "v1.5.0 removes --compat-mode; upgrade guidance and fallback options are documented." Landing PR: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/docs/pulls/214.

sam (Release): Scheduling deploy 09:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to release lead, docs owner, and oncall. I'll post telemetry here during canary.

ana (SDK): Thanks all. Tagging this thread as rollout coordination. I'll monitor telemetry and post any anomalies.
